new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Enchanted equipment facet
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Substrate, compatible inscription/binding, energy/source, crafting project, activation rule, maintenance and countermeasure
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: An item broken beyond function does not remain operational unless independent anchoring is specified

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Bound focus or reservoir
owner_fields: K-ACTOR or K-STOCK for the actual resource
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Resource species, initial charge lot/pool, capacity, allowed users, input/output, leakage/recharge model
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Possessing focus does not give expertise; charging is not free

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Potion or infused consumable
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Formula, dosage, contents, potency model, ingestion/contact path, shelf life, side effects, effect channel
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: One consumed dose cannot also remain as inventory

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Ward or boundary field
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Anchor/location, source/upkeep, protection target, coverage, limits, detection, bypass/maintenance
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Protection applies once and is not universal invulnerability

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Portal / teleportation link
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Endpoint geometry, direction, payload/mass capacity, energy/time, authorization, transit state, abort/failure
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Opening portal does not spawn arriving cargo or reset supplies

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Summoned autonomous ally
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Origin/identity, consent/control terms, arrival, duration, upkeep, return, communication
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Summoning is not a free extra attack or automatic obedience

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Conjured commodity
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Source/cost, product spec, quantity, acceptance, permanence and degradation
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Forecast quantity and effect description are not actual new stock until successful creation

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Dragonlike organism variant
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Actual anatomy, flight mass and environment, breath delivery, ecology, needs, intelligence and prey
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: No free flight, breath, immunity or boss actions from the name

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Undead animated body
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Corpse provenance/location/condition, animation source, control, upkeep, sensory/motion means
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Animation does not restore original soul, rights, memories or healing by default

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Elemental / manifest spirit
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Substrate, identity, agency, location, duration, limits, environmental needs and harm channels
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: Elemental does not mean immunity to all mundane causes

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Shapeshifter / cursed form
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Trigger, anatomy, mass, inventory interaction, cognition, duration, reversibility, injuries
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: No duplication of body/gear; existing injuries persist unless explicitly changed

new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.name: Construct or golem
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.requirements: Power, sensors, autonomy, control authority, means, maintenance, damage map and shutdown
new_fantasy_archetype_bindings.limitations: No universal mental immunity; cannot execute commands beyond capability
